parsed.text: This packet gives fallible 4x4 location distributions for red and blue at nodes n0–n3 in two panels (p0, p1). Current estimates: in both panels n0 blue peaks at cell (0,1) and red peaks at (0,3) with very high peak probabilities; n1 and n2 are currently uniform across the 4×4 grid for both roles; p0 current n3 places blue mass on the upper-right 2×2 block ((0,2),(0,3),(1,2),(1,3)) and red mass on the upper-left 2×2 block ((0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)). Conditional candidate records differ only at node n3 in some commands: in both panels command k0 shows the same p0-style quadrant split at n3; command k1 leaves n3 uniform; command k2 concentrates p3-like peaks at (1,2) for blue and (0,1) for red in panel p1 (and in p0 k2 blue at (1,2), red at (0,1)).
